title: Demand for more stories set in the water

tellings.quote: he was saying in the second season you need to do more stuff in the water.

plain: Bryce Zabel, who made the 1996 UFO television series Dark Skies in Los Angeles, says a man he calls "the captain" told him that in the second season "you need to do more stuff in the water." Zabel tells it as something said to him directly, hinting that someone wanted the show to point viewers toward the oceans.
